source.post_text: As a small restaurant owner, would you be upset if someone came and ordered food 40 minutes before your business was closing?

replies.text: No I wouldn't. Still open means still serving, and small spots can use the extra cash from late orders.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: Nope. I would want the biz🤷‍♂️
replies.author: @AceOutlaw90

replies.text: No I worked 15 yrs in restuarants  happened every night

replies.text: If I’m a “small restaurant owner” I think I’d just appreciate any customers who come in tbh
